author: Michael Larabel
description: Cambalache 1.0 released today after more than five years in development as a What You See Is What You Get (WYSIWYG) application for creating and editing user interfaces for both GTK3 and GTK4...
title: Cambalache 1.0 Released After Five Years For Designing Modern GTK UIs

author: Michael Larabel
description: OpenShot 3.5 hit the web today for this open-source non-linear video editor that describes the new version as one of their "biggest releases" ever in its 18+ year history...
title: OpenShot 3.5 Released As One Of Their "Biggest Releases" Ever

author: Michael Larabel
description: Wine 11.5 is out today as the latest bi-weekly development release for this software to run Windows games and applications on Linux and other platforms. Most exciting with Wine 11.5 is the introduction of the Syscall User Dispatch feature on Linux...
title: Wine 11.5 Release Is Big: Syscall User Dispatch Feature Supported On Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to last night's Steam client beta with Steam Runtime container support for the client and that SteamRT3 client now a 64-bit build, Valve also released a big preview update to the forthcoming SteamOS 3.8. The SteamOS 3.8 preview release brings initial support for Steam Machine hardware, various handheld gaming device support improvements, various other Steam Deck updates, improved compatibility with newer Intel and AMD platforms, and its KDE Plasma desktop is now using Wayland by default...
title: SteamOS 3.8 Preview Preps For Steam Machine, KDE Plasma Desktop With Wayland By Default

author: Michael Larabel
description: Earlier this month was a preview of the Ubuntu 26.04 performance benefits for NVIDIA Linux gaming while today's article is providing an early look at how the open-source AMD Radeon gaming experience is looking for the upcoming Ubuntu 26.04 LTS release.
title: Ubuntu 26.04 Delivers Enhanced Performance For AMD Radeon Linux Gaming

author: Michael Larabel
description: Asahi Linux developers have been working for a while now on porting Asahi Linux to the Apple M3 hardware that launched back in 2023. Sent out today to the Linux kernel mailing list were finally Device Tree files for booting Linux on Apple M3 hardware but it's far from functional for end-users...
title: Patches Sent Out For Booting Linux On Apple M3 But Without Much Functionality

author: Michael Larabel
description: Ubuntu maker Canonical announced today MicroCloud Cluster Manager that is now in beta as a new cloud platform for managing lightweight cloud clusters...
title: Ubuntu Maker Canonical Announces MicroCloud Cluster Manager

author: Michael Larabel
description: Vulkan 1.4.347 made its debut overnight as the latest routine update to this high performance graphics and compute API. Beyond the usual maintenance churn over the past week, Vulkan 1.4.347 brings three new extensions...
title: Vulkan 1.4.347 Debuts With Three New Extensions

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's been nearly three years since the release of Mageia 9 for this Linux distribution who's lineage traces back to the glorious Mandrake Linux. Following the Mageia 10 alpha release back in January, Mageia 10 beta builds are now available...
title: Mageia 10 Beta Now Available For Those Who Reminisce About Mandrake Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: Sent out today was the latest weekly round of drm-misc-next patches for queuing ahead of the Linux 7.1 merge window that is set to happen in mid-to-late April...
title: Linux 7.1 Adding DRM Dedicated CRTC Background Color Property

author: Michael Larabel
description: An interesting new Steam client beta dropped overnight from Valve with some exciting low-level enhancements...
title: Steam Linux Beta Prepares For 64-bit, Can Be Run Inside Steam Runtime Container
